tier.description: Blast radius, chosen by reversibility rather than size. local: nothing outside this repository depends on it. contract: a published API, event shape or schema something else consumes. data: a migration, or anything reverting the code does not undo.

approved_by.description: The person who approved this plan. Written by them, not by a skill: it is the gate.

approved_at.description: When it was approved. Required alongside approved_by - a name with no date says nothing about which version of the plan was approved.

allOf.description: Approval is both fields or neither.
